company.shortDescription: Trigger.dev provides a developer platform for building and managing background jobs and workflows in web applications.
company.description: Trigger.dev is a developer platform for building and running background jobs, workflows, and long-running tasks in web applications. It helps developers handle asynchronous processes like APIs, queues, and scheduled tasks with improved reliability and observability. The platform is designed to simplify backend workflow orchestration.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for writing and running background jobs and AI workflows using normal async code, with automatic scaling, retries, and observability, without managing infrastructure.
productsAndServices.name: Trigger.dev Background Jobs & AI Infrastructure

productsAndServices.description: A system to build and run AI workflows by chaining prompts, routing tasks to AI models, parallelizing execution, and coordinating multiple AI agents.
productsAndServices.name: Trigger.dev AI Task Orchestration

productsAndServices.description: An API and system to stream real-time task status and LLM responses to frontends, enabling live updates and interactive AI agents.
productsAndServices.name: Trigger.dev Realtime API and Streams

productsAndServices.description: A feature set allowing customization of the build process by adding system packages, binaries, and custom tooling to support specific project requirements.
productsAndServices.name: Trigger.dev Build Extensions

productsAndServices.description: An open-source version of Trigger.dev that can be self-hosted, allowing users to deploy and manage the platform on their own infrastructure.
productsAndServices.name: Trigger.dev Self-Hosting
